jobDescription: A commercial lender serving small and medium-sized businesses is hiring a product owner for its online lending portal, which relationship managers and business customers use to apply for loans, upload documents and track covenants. The product owner defines the portal strategy and takes it through the digital steering committee, manages the backlog with the delivery team, gathers requirements from relationship managers and credit officers, coordinates user acceptance testing with lending operations and reports delivery progress and benefits to the sponsor. The committee meets every two months and expects a written paper with options and measurable targets.
requirements: Defines the product strategy for the commercial lending portal and secures steering committee approval.
Manages the backlog with the delivery team in two-week sprints.
Gathers requirements from relationship managers and credit officers.
Coordinates user acceptance testing with lending operations.
Reports delivery progress and benefits against the strategy metrics to the sponsor.

evidence.text: Product owner at Grayfield Commercial Finance (SME lending), November 2020 to present, working on the online lending portal used by relationship managers and business customers.
Wrote the 2024 product strategy paper for the portal and presented it to the digital steering committee, which approved it in February 2024.

Ran fortnightly sprint planning and backlog refinement with a delivery team of nine engineers and testers, keeping the next two sprints' stories estimated and agreeing release scope with the lending operations lead before each quarter.
Held requirement workshops with relationship managers and credit officers on document upload and covenant tracking, and turned the outputs into user stories with acceptance criteria.
Organised user acceptance testing with the lending operations team for each quarterly release, tracking defects to closure, and sent a monthly progress update to the sponsor.

Work sample: the anonymised 2024 strategy paper, with the problem statement, three strategic bets and a target metric for each, followed by an extract of the steering committee minutes recording approval and the two conditions attached to it.

Reference check summary (former sponsor, the chief digital officer): confirmed in writing that the candidate wrote and presented the 2024 strategy paper and that the committee approved it in February 2024.
HR verification note: employment at Grayfield Commercial Finance since November 2020 and the title Product Owner were confirmed by the employer's HR team.
